2014_spells.spider-climb.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.
2014_spells.spider-climb.effectSummary: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.spider-climb.fullDescription: Using 1 action, until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed. Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
